title: Legal Administrator
description:
Paralegal (temporary)

Venn Group's specialist Private Practice Legal Recruitment team is recruiting a temporary Paralegal for a highly regarded law firm in York. The role offers an excellent opportunity to broaden your legal experience and would suit someone who is immediately available on a full-time basis and has previous legal experience within a law firm.

The role

You will be responsible for:
- Acting as the primary contact for clients, ensuring smooth and efficient transaction progress by facilitating communication between clients, fee earners, and support staff
- The position supports a wide range of legal settings, combining fee-earning and administrative duties such as managing caseloads, drafting legal documents, reviewing case materials, and preparing or distributing financial records

About you
- The ideal candidate will have previous experience providing administrative support to a busy Commercial Property plot sales team within private practice, however general legal experience may also be considered.

Key details
- Hourly rate: £12.71 - £14.00 per hour
- Location: York
- Contract: Temporary
- Start: Week commencing 5th October
- Initial length of assignment: Week commencing 5th October - 27th November with the potential of extension

title: Paralegal
company: LSL Property Services plc - Agency - Permanent
description:
LSL is a one of the largest providers of services to mortgage intermediaries, specialist mortgage and protection advice to estate agency and new build customers and valuation services to the UK's biggest mortgage lenders. It also operates a network of owned and franchised estate agency branches.

Based within our Group Legal Team in York, we are looking to recruit a Paralegal to provide support to the Group Legal Team with a wide variety of matters spanning across all areas of the LSL Group.

Location: York - on site office-based.

Role Purpose

To provide legal and administrative support to the Legal Team, assisting with a broad range of legal matters and ensuring the efficient delivery of legal services across the business. The role supports solicitors, contract administration, regulatory compliance, and corporate transactions whilst maintaining high standards of accuracy and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct legal research and prepare summaries, reports, and recommendations.
- Draft, review, and amend legal documents, including contracts, NDAs, agreements, and correspondence.
- Support solicitors and legal professionals on commercial, corporate, regulatory, and dispute resolution matters.
- Assist with contract management, document control, and legal record keeping.
- Monitor legal deadlines and maintain case and matter tracking systems.
- Prepare documentation for corporate transactions and business projects.
- Support regulatory and compliance activities.
- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external legal advisers where required.
- Assist with updating policies, procedures, and customer-facing terms and conditions.
- Ensure confidential information is handled appropriately at all times.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
- Law degree, Legal Practice qualification, or equivalent legal education.
- Previous paralegal experience desirable but not essential.
- Strong legal research and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal document management systems.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of legal risk.

Key Competencies
- Analytical thinking
- Attention to detail
- Professional integrity
- Communication and influencing
- Organisation and planning
- Problem solving
- Teamwork and collaboration
- Customer and stakeholder focus

Apply

If you feel you match our requirements and are looking for your next career challenge, or for a confidential discussion on the full details of this role please contact Alka Tarafdar

title: Paralegal - Family
description:
As a Family Care Paralegal within the Family Team, you will provide comprehensive legal and administrative support to Solicitors and Legal Advisers working on public law children matters.
This role offers an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within Family Care law and gain hands-on experience in a busy and supportive legal environment.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
- Assist Solicitors and Legal Advisers with a range of Family Care matters, including care proceedings and pre-proceedings work.
- Support clients through sensitive and often emotionally challenging matters with professionalism, empathy, and discretion.
- Progress delegated tasks efficiently and accurately, ensuring work is completed within required timescales.
- Draft routine correspondence, legal documents, witness statements, chronologies, and applications for review.
- Liaise with clients, Courts, Local Authorities, Counsel, CAFCASS, experts, and other third parties as required.
- Attend Court and client meetings where appropriate.
- Open, maintain, and update client files using the firm's case management system.
- Ensure all documentation is filed, stored, and managed in line with firm procedures and regulatory requirements.
- Maintain accurate records, attendance notes, and case updates.
- Monitor and assist with meeting Court deadlines and case progression requirements.
- Assist with the preparation and management of Court bundles and supporting documentation.
- Prepare and format legal documents, forms, applications, statements, and correspondence.
- Ensure documents are accurate, professionally presented, and compliant with firm standards.
- Comply with all firm policies and procedures, including file management, client due diligence, and data protection requirements.
- Assist with preparing cost information and client communications where required.
- Record time accurately in line with departmental expectations.
- Support billing, Legal Aid administration, and other administrative processes as appropriate.
- Assist with the management of disbursements and Court-related expenses where required.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- Relevant legal qualification (e.g. Law Degree, LPC, SQE, CILEX or equivalent) or relevant practical experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and work to strict deadlines.
- Professional, client-focused approach with high levels of integrity and confidentiality.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Ability to work independently on delegated tasks and as part of a team.
- Previous experience working within Family Law
- Experience of care proceedings
- Experience preparing Court bundles and legal documentation.
- Experience supporting vulnerable clients and handling sensitive matters.
- Familiarity with Court procedures and deadlines.
- Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel between offices, Courts, and client meetings where required.

BENEFITS:
Salary: £26,000 - £28,000
Pension, DIS. Business Events, Hybrid Working

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
